rules.title: Cambridge policy order to develop ban on algorithmic rent-pricing services
rules.requirement: The Cambridge City Council has started work on a possible ban on residential property management companies hiring firms that use algorithmic or AI models to recommend rents. Nothing is banned yet, and the City Manager is to bring back policy options or ordinance language.
rules.coverage_conditions: Proposed to apply to residential property management companies in Cambridge. Whether a landlord uses pricing software is regulated conduct, not a coverage limit, so the proposal would reach any rental in the city. The source names no building-type limits.
rules.citation: Cambridge City Council policy order (number not stated in source)
rules.reason: There was only one candidate, a news report of a unanimously passed council policy order starting work on a ban. It stays pending, and I removed the coverage condition about using pricing software because that is regulated conduct, not a building limit.
